```{r Data Preprocessing}
library(disdat)
library(mgcv)
library(sf)
library(spatstat)
library(fields)
library(tmap)
library(grid)
library(units)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(glmnet)
library(scampr)
#install.packages("glmmTMB_1.1.9-9000.tar.gz",  repos = NULL, type = "source")
library(glmmTMB)
set.seed(0)

# get the data
source("get_and_format_flora_data.R")
rm(dat_pa)

# get the relevant predictors according to pred_set (these are all basically derived from elevation, we are just looking at moisture and temp. covars and soil fertility score and disturbance index)
# preds <- switch(pred_set,
#                 A = "None",
#                 B = c("mi", "tempann"),
#                 C = c("mi", "tempann", "mi2", "tempann2"),
# )

# get a vector of the factor terms
facts <- c("disturb", "soilfert", "vegsis")

# load the species information
load("flora_species.RDATA")

# get the groups to which the flora species belongs to subset the data
flora_groups <- unique(sp.info$group)

# subset the presence-only data (in the case we are using restricted species)
pres <- pres[pres$group %in% flora_groups, ]

# want to use species with at least 10 presences
pres <- pres[pres$spid %in% names(table(pres$spid))[table(pres$spid) >= 10], ]

# get the species
species <- unique(pres$spid)

# assign some numbers
m <- length(species) # responses
q <- nrow(quad) # quadrature points

# add in the quadrature for each species (replicates of the supplied background points)
quad$spid <- rep(NA, q) #label each replicate block with its species id
dat <- rbind(pres, quad)
n <- nrow(dat)

quad_rep <- quad[rep(seq_len(q), m), ]
quad_rep$spid <- rep(species, each = q) # assign the species id's
dat_rep = rbind(pres, quad_rep)

# set the coordinates to x and y so we can just use default labels
dat$lon <- dat$x; dat$lat <- dat$y; dat$x <- dat$xm; dat$y <- dat$ym; dat$xm <- NULL; dat$ym <- NULL
dat_rep$lon <- dat_rep$x; dat_rep$lat <- dat_rep$y; dat_rep$x <- dat_rep$xm; dat_rep$y <- dat_rep$ym; dat_rep$xm <- NULL; dat_rep$ym <- NULL

load("domain.RDATA")
domain$lon <- domain$x; domain$lat <- domain$y; domain$x <- domain$xm; domain$y <- domain$ym; domain$xm <- NULL; domain$ym <- NULL

gc()
```


```{r}
# need a function to strip environments from the model objects so they can be saved without being massive
rm.env <- function(m) {
  attr(attr(m$frame, "terms"), ".Environment") <- NULL
  attr(m$modelInfo$terms$cond$fixed, ".Environment") <- NULL
  attr(m$modelInfo$reTrms$cond$terms$fixed, ".Environment") <- NULL
  attr(m$modelInfo$allForm$combForm, ".Environment") <- NULL
  attr(m$modelInfo$allForm$formula, ".Environment") <- NULL
  attr(m$modelInfo$allForm$ziformula, ".Environment") <- NULL
  attr(m$modelInfo$allForm$dispformula, ".Environment") <- NULL
  m
}
```


```{r Build spatial basis functions}
bfs <- make_basis(k = 50, domain, from.package = "scampr")

# need to prune in the case of scampr bfs
if (is(bfs, "scampr.bf")) {
  tmp <- bf_matrix(bfs, rbind(pres[,c("xm", "ym")], quad[,c("xm", "ym")])) # via the data?
  tmp <- bf_matrix(bfs, pres[,c("xm", "ym")]) # via the data?
  bf.check <- apply(tmp, 2, function(x){sum(x > 0)})
  bfs <- bfs[bf.check != 0, ]
  rm(tmp, bf.check)
}

#evaluate basis functions at every data point
Z_star = bf_matrix(bfs, dat[, c("x", "y")])
#Z_star = Z_star/max(apply(Z_star,2,sd)) #some standardisation needed for ridge fits

pres_rows = seq_len(nrow(pres))
quad_rows = nrow(pres) + seq_len(nrow(quad))
                 
Z_pres = Z_star[pres_rows, , drop = FALSE]
Z_quad = Z_star[quad_rows, , drop = FALSE]

n_species = length(species)
Z_quad_rep = Z_quad[rep(seq_len(nrow(Z_quad)), n_species), , drop = FALSE]
Z_row = rbind(Z_pres, Z_quad_rep)
```



```{r Fitting - alternating column/row updates (single latent spatial factor R CRASHES DURING SPECIES UPDATE LOOP}

#initialise shared latent spatial field coefficients (u), one per basis function
u = rnorm(ncol(Z_star), 0, 1)

# Rename spid
dat_rename = dat_rep %>% 
  mutate(spid = as.numeric(str_extract(dat_rep$spid, "\\d+")))

pres_spid = as.numeric(str_extract(pres$spid, "\\d+"))

attach(dat_rename)
Z_pres_u = Z_pres %*% u 
Z_quad_u = Z_quad %*% u 

chosen_spid = unique(pres_spid)

X_full = cbind(1, mi, tempann)
X_pres_full = cbind(1, pres$mi, pres$tempann)
X_quad_full = cbind(1, quad$mi, quad$tempann)

beta_lambda = matrix(NA,  nrow = n_species, ncol = ncol(Z_pres_u) + ncol(X_pres_full))

#rows_by_species = split(seq_len(nrow(dat_rename)), spid)
rows_by_species = split(seq_len(nrow(pres)), pres_spid)
species_idx_pres = match(pres_spid, chosen_spid)
species_idx_row = match(spid, chosen_spid)

N = 100
loglik = -Inf
max_it = 3

time_i = system.time({for (iter in 1:N){
  X_pres_Zu = cbind(X_pres_full, Z_pres_u)
  X_quad_Zu = cbind(X_quad_full, Z_quad_u)

  for (j in seq_along(chosen_spid)){
    i = chosen_spid[j]
    idx = rows_by_species[[as.character(i)]]
    
    X_i = rbind(X_pres_Zu[idx, ], X_quad_Zu)
    
    y_i = c(dat$occ[idx]/dat$wt[idx], rep(0, nrow(quad)))

    w_i = c(dat$wt[idx], quad$wt)

    start_iter = if (all(is.finite(beta_lambda[j, ]))) {
      beta_lambda[j, ]
      } else {
        NULL
        }

    glm1 = glm.fit(y = y_i, x = X_i, family = poisson(link = 'log'), weights = w_i, intercept = TRUE, start = start_iter, control = glm.control(maxit = max_it))
    
    # store this species' intercept + beta + lambda (1 loading)
    beta_lambda[j, ] = t(c(glm1$coefficients))  
  }

  #split fitted coefficients into fixed effects (beta) and basis-function loadings (lambda)
  beta_lambda
  beta = beta_lambda[, 1:ncol(X_pres_full)] 
  lambda = as.matrix(beta_lambda[, (ncol(X_pres_full) + 1):ncol(beta_lambda)]) 
  
  lambda_rep = lambda[species_idx_row, , drop = TRUE]

  offset = rowSums(X_full * beta[species_idx_row, , drop = FALSE])

  Zl_joint = Z_row * lambda_rep 

  start_iter_u = if (all(is.finite(u))) {
    u} else {
      NULL
      }

  glm1 = glm.fit(x = Zl_joint, y = occ/wt, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), weights = wt, offset = as.numeric(offset), start = start_iter_u, control = glm.control(maxit = max_it))
  
  new_u = as.numeric(glm1$coefficients)

  u = new_u
  print(u)
  
  # Rebuild Zu with updated u, for next iteration's column update
  Z_pres_u = Z_pres %*% u 
  Z_quad_u = Z_quad %*% u

  eta = offset + (Z_row * lambda_rep) %*% u
  mu = exp(eta)
  pred_mglm_oneq = mu
  
  #weighted Poisson-process log-likelihood (DWPR/Berman-Turner approximation)
  loglik_new_mglm_oneq = sum(occ * log(mu) - wt * mu)
  cat("iter", iter, "loglik:", loglik_new_mglm_oneq, "\n")
  
  #stop once relative change in log-likelihood is small
  if (is.finite(loglik) && abs(loglik_new_mglm_oneq - loglik)/ max(1, abs(loglik_new_mglm_oneq)) < 1e-6) break
  loglik = loglik_new_mglm_oneq}
})
save(loglik_new_mglm_oneq, file = "loglik_new_mglm_oneq.RDATA")

time_mglm_oneq = as.numeric(time_i[3])
time_mglm_oneq
save(time_mglm_oneq, file = "time_mglm_oneq.RDATA")
```

```{r Intensity map for a chosen species}
X_domain = cbind(1, domain$mi, domain$tempann)
Z_domain_star = bf_matrix(bfs, domain[, c("x", "y")])

Zu_domain = Z_domain_star %*% u

target_species_id <- 19
j = match(target_species_id, chosen_spid)

sp_fld_glmnet = X_domain %*% beta[j, ] + Zu_domain %*% lambda[j, ]

domain$log_intensity = as.numeric(sp_fld_glmnet[, 1])

library(stars)
```
